Read in Packages
```{r packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(tmap)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
library(readxl)
library(reticulate)

#Read in python scraper functions
use_condaenv("C:/Users/smartinez63/Anaconda3") #Change this path to wherever your python binary is stored. If you're not using conda you can switch to use_python(directory_to_binary)
source_python('./OASIS Web Scraper.py')
```



### **Load in Data**

This chunk reads in data from the *OASIS Web Scraper.py* script. That script parses HTML data from the [!Georgia OASIS](https://oasis.state.ga.us/) site.

```{python}
oasis = oasis_parse_data(raw_text = oasis_prep_htmls(extension = '\Data'))
```

```{r load scraped data}
#Set the year and projection
year <- 2020
epsg_id <- 26967

#Read in health data from scraped htmls
health_scrape_raw <- py$oasis %>%
  mutate(tract = as.character(tract))

#Read in tabular exported data from OASIS
respiratory_deaths <- read_xlsx('./Data/respiratory_deaths.xlsx', skip = 1) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Geography) & !is.na(`\nNumber of Deaths`)) %>%
  mutate('Respiratory Deaths' = as.numeric(`\nNumber of Deaths`), .keep = 'unused')

total_deaths <- read_xlsx('./Data/total_deaths.xlsx', skip = 1) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Geography) & !is.na(`\nNumber of Deaths`)) %>%
  mutate('Total Deaths' = as.numeric(`\nNumber of Deaths`), .keep = 'unused')

#Concatenate all data into one frame
health_data_joined <- full_join(health_scrape_raw, respiratory_deaths, by = c('tract' = 'Geography')) %>%
  full_join(total_deaths, by = c('tract' = 'Geography'))
```

This chunk loads in required acs-5 data to get tract population. Since we want to normalize the scraped data into rates, we need the population.

**NOTE**: As of the writing of this script (10/13/2022), ACS-5 data was only available for 2020. Therefore rate estimates from 2021 health data are normalized using 2020 population data. Please update once 2021 population data is available.

```{r load tract geometries and population, results = 'hide'}
#Get census tract population for 2021 using ACS 5-year estimates
census_api_key('cf3c51073f5e6be8f75b96e5c12662a25525326b')

acs_codebook <- load_variables(year = year, dataset = 'acs5')

#Get population data from acs5
henry_acs <- get_acs(geography = 'tract',
                     state = 'GA', 
                     county = 'Henry County', 
                     variables = c('Population' = 'B01003_001'), 
                     year = year, 
                     survey = 'acs5', 
                     output = 'wide',
                     geometry = TRUE) %>%
  
  #Drop unneeded fields
  select(-c(NAME, 'PopulationM')) %>%
  
  #Project
  st_transform(crs = epsg_id)

#Get 2010 census tracts
henry_2010_tracts <- tigris::tracts(state = 'GA', county = 'Henry', year = 2010) %>%
  
  #Drop unneeded fields
  select(NAMELSAD10, GEOID10, geometry) %>%
  
  #Project
  st_transform(crs = epsg_id)
```

### **Merge New Census Tracts with Old Census Tracts**

```{R}
#Plot where 2020 tracts overlap 2010 tracts
tmap_mode('view')
tm_shape(henry_2010_tracts) + 
  tm_polygons(border.col = 'red', border.alpha = 0.3) + 
  tm_shape(henry_acs) + 
  tm_polygons(lty = 'dashed', alpha = 0.3, border_col = 'black')

#Union by feature
henry_acs_union <- henry_acs %>%
  st_join(st_buffer(henry_2010_tracts, 200), join = st_within) %>%
  group_by(`GEOID10`, `NAMELSAD10`) %>%
  summarize(geometry = st_union(geometry), population = sum(PopulationE)) %>%
  st_as_sf() %>%
  st_transform(crs = epsg_id)

#Plot the coerced 2020 tracts on top of the 2010 tracts
tmap_mode('view')
tm_shape(henry_2010_tracts) + tm_borders(col = 'blue', lwd = 4, alpha = 0.3) +
  tm_shape(henry_acs_union) + tm_borders(col = 'red', lwd = 4, alpha = 0.3)
```

### **Append Health Data to Geometry**

```{r}
#Add health data to population data
henry_health_final <- henry_acs_union %>%
  left_join(health_data_joined, by = c('GEOID10' = 'tract')) %>%
  
  #Normalize variables by tract population
  mutate(across(-any_of(c('GEOID10', 'NAMELSAD10', 'geometry', 'population')), 
                .fns = ~ (.x/population) %>% signif(2))) %>%
  
  #Rename variables
  rename('GEOID' = 'GEOID10',
         'Tract Name' = 'NAMELSAD10',
         'Tract Population' = 'population',
         'ACSC Hospital Discharge Rate' = 'acsc_discharges',
         'ACSC ER Visit Rate' = 'acsc_er_visits',
         'ER Visit Rate (Respiratory Conditions)' = 'respiratory_er_visits',
         'Hospital Discharge Rate (Respiratory Conditions)' = 'respiratory_hosp_discharges',
         'Death Rate (Respiratory Conditions)' = 'Respiratory Deaths',
         'Death Rate' = 'Total Deaths'
  )

#Generate shapefile
st_write(henry_health_final, './Exports/henry_health.shp', append = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#Get Henry County outline geometry
henry_geometry <- st_union(henry_health_final)

#Generate plot of variables
tmap_mode('plot')
tmap_options(bg.color = '#f0f0f0',
             legend.position = c('left','bottom'), 
             legend.bg.color = '#cee0db', 
             legend.frame = 'black',
             legend.frame.lwd = 1.5,
             title.size = .75,
             title.fontface = 'bold',
             title.position = c('center', 'top'),
             frame = FALSE
)

resp_er_map <- tm_shape(henry_health_final) +
  tm_polygons(col = 'ER Visit Rate (Respiratory Conditions)', style = 'cont', legend.is.portrait = FALSE, title = '') +
  tm_layout(title = 'ER Visit Rate (Respiratory Conditions)') +
  tm_shape(henry_geometry) + tm_borders(lwd = 2)

resp_hosp_map <- tm_shape(henry_health_final) +
  tm_polygons(col = 'Hospital Discharge Rate (Respiratory Conditions)', style = 'cont', legend.is.portrait = FALSE, title = '') +
  tm_layout(title = 'Hospital Discharge Rate (Respiratory Conditions)') +
  tm_shape(henry_geometry) + tm_borders(lwd = 2)

acsc_hosp_map <- tm_shape(henry_health_final) +
  tm_polygons(col = 'ACSC Hospital Discharge Rate', style = 'cont', legend.is.portrait = FALSE, title = '') +
  tm_layout(title = 'Hospital Discharge Rate (All ACSC Conditions)') +
  tm_shape(henry_geometry) + tm_borders(lwd = 2)

acsc_er_map <- tm_shape(henry_health_final) +
  tm_polygons(col = 'ACSC ER Visit Rate', style = 'cont', legend.is.portrait = FALSE, title = '') +
  tm_layout(title = 'ER Visit Rate (All ACSC Conditions)') +
  tm_shape(henry_geometry) + tm_borders(lwd = 2)

tmap_arrange(resp_er_map, acsc_er_map, ncol = 2, nrow = 1, sync = TRUE) %>% print(knit = TRUE)
tmap_arrange(resp_hosp_map, acsc_hosp_map, ncol = 2, nrow = 1, sync = TRUE) %>% print(knit = TRUE)

tmap_options_reset()

```
